jobs.title: Director of Cloud Software Engineering
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Director of Cloud Software Engineering  

**Department:** Information Technology

**Location:** Remote Must Reside in East Coast Time Zone

**Hours Per Week:** 40 hours  

**Schedule:** Days, Monday – Friday

**SUMMARY**  

The Director of Cloud Software Engineering leads the design, development, deployment, operation and maintenance of cloud\-native software platforms and applications. This role is responsible for managing engineering teams, defining cloud development strategy, defining code development CI/CD process, driving architectural excellence, and ensuring the scalability, reliability, security, and performance of cloud\-based solutions.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Assist in the definition and execute the organization’s cloud software engineering roadmap.
* Establish engineering best practices, coding standards/review, and development methodologies.
* Drive innovation in cloud\-native application development and modernization initiatives.
* Partner with executive leadership to align technology initiatives with business goals.
* Partner with business leads and IT business analysts to support development of functional requirements.
* Build and maintain a high\-performance engineering culture focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Working collaboratively with IT CSV and IT business analysts to support computer system validation/assurance activities.
* Lead and mentor multiple organizational teams.
* Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent.
* Conduct performance evaluations, career development planning, and succession planning.
* Manage resource allocation, budgeting, vendor relationships, and work with ACM PMO to manage project prioritization and resourcing.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and technical excellence.
* Oversee the architecture, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of scalable cloud applications and platforms.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer (AI/ML)
jobs.description:
About INflow Federal \- founded in 2013, INflow Federal is a mission\-driven small business delivering cutting\-edge solutions to the Department of War (DoW) and Joint Force operations across 20\+ states. Our strength comes from our people \- especially the Veterans who make up over 50% of our workforce. Through our Veteran Outreach Program and employee\-first culture, we invest deeply in professional growth, well\-being, and innovation. Known for our agility, transparency, and integrity, INflow combines real\-world experience with emerging technologies like AI/ML to help our customers lead in a rapidly evolving defense landscape. We empower both our employees and mission partners to stay ahead \- driving smarter, faster, and more secure outcomes.
### **Job Overview:**

  

As a Software Developer at INflow Federal, you'll build and ship AI features for Ontology\-based mission applications supporting an Intelligence Community customer. This is TS/SCI, on\-site work at Patriot Ridge in Springfield, VA — the applications you write go directly to systems and analysts working real intelligence problems.



In this role, you will develop LLM\-enabled workflows and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities inside existing mission software, integrate data streams from multiple sources and network environments into the customer's system, and execute cloud platform migrations across AWS, OpenShift, and Kubernetes. You'll work in Python, Java, and Scala on an agile scrum team, applying DevSecOps practices — code hardening, automated security scanning, CI/CD — so that what you build survives contact with complex, secure networks.



Here, your work is more than a job—it's a journey in innovation. With opportunities to work on high\-impact projects, access to the latest technologies, and a culture that thrives on creativity and collaboration, INflow Federal is where your expertise can truly make a difference.
